openGates.summary: Implementation and the Ubuntu round-two verifier are present; obtain admitted live filesystem, retained-handle, reboot, and physical power-loss receipts.

Policy-v2 hybrid verification and the offline signer are implemented; return the root-signed delegation, operational public bundle and signed external evidence, then replace the exact zero digest placeholders.

The statically linked in-process receipt seam is implemented and app-kernel-bound; return an offline-signed exact-host profile plus current platform and durability evidence before production activation.

Canonical .slide, flat package ABI/import/resource, affine VOK and typed receipts are implemented. Dynamic routing, broader closed bodies, effects, mutation/manual memory, callbacks, initialisers and production authentication remain open.
Current debt is 537 TypeScript paths, 2551 unexecuted Fungi sources, 57 host boundaries, 95 package dependency trees and one nested package. Each must reach zero through exact admission.

The seven-OS digest-pinned release gate and public receipt workflow are implemented; return Windows 10, Windows 11, Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Linux Mint and macOS receipts without inferring untested hosts.

The primary checkout does not contain the unpushed implementation. Keep C12/C18, signing custody, independent audit, remaining semantic scope and physical/production receipts open; do not infer corpus, queue, signing, SLIDE/VOK or .fungi assurance.
